summary: A significant cross-regional confrontation is underway following reports that US forces conducted strikes near the Strait of Hormuz, with Trump claiming control of the strait and destruction of vessels. Iran's IRGC announced retaliatory strikes targeting US positions in Kuwait and the UAE using missiles and drones, while Iran's currency collapsed to record lows. Israeli forces continued operations in northern Gaza, eliminating a militant who crossed the Yellow Line, and conducted airstrikes on the Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon.
key_points: Trump claimed the US now controls the Strait of Hormuz and destroyed 28 ships in strikes Tuesday night, and suggested renaming it 'TRUMP STRAIT,' while saying Iran was two weeks from a nuclear weapon. (Source: @VahidOnline/78191)

The IRGC announced strikes targeting US air defense communication systems, equipment depots, and aircraft shelters at Ahmed Al-Jaber Air Base in Kuwait, as well as radar systems and troop positions in the UAE, using missiles and drones. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388527)
Air Force fighter jets struck targets in the Ali al-Taher ridge area in southern Lebanon in a recent operation, according to Israeli media. (Source: @yediotnews25/134606)
IDF identified a militant who crossed the Yellow Line into northern Gaza and approached troops; the Air Force struck and eliminated him as an immediate threat. (Source: @idf_telegram/25039)
Iran warned the US it would respond forcefully if Israel attacked the Ali al-Taher ridge, where senior IRGC officials are reportedly hiding in the mountain. (Source: @N12chat/224764)
Iran's rial collapsed to approximately 2.2 million IRR per USD, with the euro surpassing 255,000 tomans and the dirham exceeding 60,000 tomans following new US attacks. (Source: @asafroz/53023)

Combat engineers of the Yahalom unit demolished a kilometer-long tunnel in northern Gaza, bringing the total tunnels destroyed since the October 2025 ceasefire to over 26 kilometers on the Israeli side of the line. (Source: @shin_persian/9419)

Israeli security forces elevated alert level overnight following intelligence of a possible Hamas attack against troops in Gaza; the planned attack was not carried out. (Source: @New_security8200/203580)

sections.executive_summary: A major US-Iran confrontation has erupted following reported strikes near the Strait of Hormuz, with Trump claiming US control of the waterway and destruction of vessels, while the IRGC announced retaliatory missile and drone strikes against US positions in Kuwait and the UAE. The Iranian rial collapsed to approximately 2.2 million per USD amid the escalation. Concurrently, Israel conducted operations in northern Gaza, eliminating a militant who crossed the Yellow Line, and struck targets on the Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, where Iran warned that senior IRGC officials are reportedly hiding.
iran: Trump stated on the Dan Patrick podcast that the US now controls the Strait of Hormuz, claimed 28 ships were destroyed in Tuesday night's strikes, and asserted the Islamic Republic was two weeks from having a nuclear weapon; he suggested renaming the strait 'TRUMP STRAIT.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78191)

The IRGC officially announced strikes on US positions using missiles and drones targeting 'air defense communication systems,' equipment depots, and aircraft shelters at Ahmed Al-Jaber Air Base in Kuwait, plus radar systems and troop positions in the UAE. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388527)

Iran's currency collapsed following US attacks: the rial fell to approximately 2.2 million IRR per USD, the euro surpassed 255,000 tomans for the first time, and the UAE dirham exceeded 60,000 tomans; the rial lost over 10% of its value in two weeks. (Source: @asafroz/53023)

Iran warned the US through diplomatic channels that it would respond forcefully if Israel struck the Ali al-Taher ridge, where senior IRGC commanders are reportedly hiding in the mountain terrain. (Source: @N12chat/224764)
Mahdi Bohrani, an IRGC militant killed on Lavan Island, was 17 years old according to Tasnim News; Fox News reported Trump may order renewed strikes tonight. (Source: @shin_persian/9427)

Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated the US will continue targeting Iran over shipping attacks and warned that any state helping Iran evade sanctions or build nuclear weapons capability will itself face US sanctions. (Source: @shin_persian/9421)
israel: PM Netanyahu near the Yellow Line in Gaza stated: 'Yesterday we took the head of Hamas's internal security. We control the territory and we are staying on this line… Gaza will no longer pose a threat to Israel.' (Source: @almogboker78/18116)

Netanyahu stated regarding Iran: 'The regime in Iran will fall. We will bring it down. It is already on its last legs. All our systems, under my guidance, act to overthrow this regime.' (Source: @shin_persian/9424)

Israel's Yahalom combat engineers demolished a kilometer-long tunnel in northern Gaza during operations of the Gaza Division's Northern Brigade, bringing total tunnels destroyed since the October 2025 ceasefire to over 26 kilometers on the Israeli side. (Source: @shin_persian/9419)

Israeli security forces raised alert levels overnight following intelligence indicating a possible Hamas attack on troops in Gaza, though the planned attack did not materialize. (Source: @New_security8200/203580)
Airstrike on Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon was reported; Iran threatened a forceful response and indicated senior IRGC figures shelter in the mountain. (Source: @yediotnews25/134606)

Police arrested a 19-year-old settler from the northern West Bank as the first suspect in Saturday's violent raid on Qusra, where dozens of settlers took over a home and attacked residents; Shin Bet participated in the investigation. (Source: @manniefabian/59086)

A kilometer-long tunnel in northern Gaza was demolished by Yahalom combat engineers during Northern Brigade operations; since the October 2025 ceasefire, over 26 km of tunnels have been destroyed on the Israeli side of the line. (Source: @shin_persian/9419)

syria_iraq: Two Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF/Hashd al-Shaabi) members were wounded when unidentified gunmen opened fire on a PMF checkpoint in the Tonn Copri area of Kirkuk province in northern Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89259)
Warplanes were observed in the skies over Kirkuk province following the terrorist attack on the PMF point. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89269)
Wall Street Journal reported the US Secretary of Defense extended the deployment of American forces in the region into 2027. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89276)

An Iraqi resistance group vowed to strike US troop positions and facilities if American forces fail to honor the September 30 deadline for the US-led coalition to end its mission and complete withdrawal. (Source: @presstv/205334)

Iran's currency collapse included the UAE dirham surpassing 60,000 tomans amid reports the UAE announced cutting financial ties with Iran as part of US economic pressure operations. (Source: @VahidOnline/78191)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has entered a direct Iran-US kinetic phase, with the IRGC claiming strikes on US positions in Kuwait and the UAE using missiles and drones. Trump asserted US control of the Strait of Hormuz and destruction of 28 vessels, indicating an aggressive posture that risks further escalation. Iran's retaliatory threats regarding the Ali al-Taher ridge, where senior IRGC officials reportedly shelter, combined with the assassination of the Hamas internal security chief, suggest coordinated multi-front operations. The potential burn mark on Prince Hassan Air Base runway in Jordan, if confirmed, signals Iranian willingness to strike beyond Gulf states, dramatically widening the threat envelope.
sections.regional_response: The Iraqi resistance threatened strikes against US positions if forces fail to withdraw by September 30, while Iraq's PMF suffered an attack in Kirkuk raising sectarian tensions. Jordan's hosting of MQ-4C drones conducting daily Iran coast reconnaissance makes Prince Hassan Air Base a likely flashpoint. The UAE's reported financial decoupling from Iran signals Gulf state alignment with US economic pressure operations. Lebanon's southern front remains active with artillery exchanges and Israeli strikes on the Ali al-Taher ridge, while Iran's stated red line there indicates potential for northern front escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israel eliminated the head of Hamas internal security while simultaneously conducting tunnel demolition operations totaling over 26 km since October 2025, indicating sustained intelligence penetration of Hamas networks. The reported 17-year-old age of IRGC casualty Mahdi Bohrani on Lavan Island suggests recruitment of very young personnel, potentially indicating IRGC manpower pressures. Senior US military commanders reportedly informed Defense Secretary Hegseth that continuing the Iran war degrades overall military readiness, suggesting internal policy friction. Iran's 10% currency loss in two weeks and record exchange rates reflect both sanctions pressure and the psychological impact of direct US strikes.
